answer: Bond decay stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 100 POA bond, logged as one onyx token on a crystal-clear ledger. It decays 5% each epoch unless verified work earns it back; after 5 idle epochs it expires. Pigment fades if never restored; an idle bond fades the same way. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA plus 5,000 POA decay per epoch, while one honest agent pays one bond and keeps it alive, so rewards are never diluted by fakes.
